about: Hyimg's design contract, derived from the code on 2026-10-06 (ui/look.css, ui/slider.css, ui/menu.js, ui/icons.js, the pages' :root, DESIGN.md and the owner's dated quotes in the comments). The values the code already uses as its system; where the code disagrees with itself the majority or the owner-stated value is the contract and the disagreement is listed under 'disagreements'. Read by scripts/validate.py (static) and design/audit.js through tests/test_design_audit.py (runtime). Words: design/CONTRACT.md.

skip_files.hyimg/review/index.html: /v1, the first review page, kept as it was (its own Onest font and palette), not part of the current app

why.cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1): THE curve of the app: 114 uses, ui/slider.js «easing cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1)», the marks' --mke, menus, key hints, editors
why.cubic-bezier(.3,.8,.25,1): DESIGN.md «Движение»: the main curve for moves and sizes, 0.4-0.8 s (the library panel, the .seg thumb, the library button's picture); 19 uses
why.cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.15): hyPop: a round button grows out of scale(0) with a small overshoot (DESIGN.md, look.css)
why.cubic-bezier(.33,0,.2,1): hyGrow's first segment (the crumb grows as a circle), a keyframe's own timing in look.css
why.cubic-bezier(.45,0,.2,1): hyGrow's second segment (the crumb opens to its width)
why.cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1): the loading lines of Home and the board (#csteps, .prog, #load): one choreography, 11 uses, kept as its own curve
why.cubic-bezier(.45,0,.15,1): hyLay, the entrance of the library's layer from 1.5 (owner 2026-10-04, a drawing), a slow symmetric 1.8 s zoom
why.ease: opacity and colour, DESIGN.md: «Прозрачность меняется быстрее, около 0.3 с, ease»
why.linear: a keyframe animation whose keyframes carry their own timing (hyGrow), spinners, progress
why.ease-in-out (loops): only in an endless breathing or pulsing loop (animation ... infinite alternate: the loading skeletons, a name loading): a symmetric curve is right there

not_allowed.ease-in-out: outside an infinite loop (the board's twinkle of the dots, 2 s once)
not_allowed.cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1): the library's filter drawer: a near copy of .3,.8,.25,1
not_allowed.cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.3): Home: a stronger overshoot than hyPop's 1.15

family.source: ui/icons.js HY_IC_LINE: Lucide geometry on a 24 grid, round caps and joins (owner 2026-10-06: Image Studio's set is the family)

chevron.source: ui/menu.js HY_CHEV (owner 2026-10-04: «the arrow must be the same everywhere»)

icons.why: 1.8 to 1.9 is the family's line as written in different files (26 + 15 + the 1.85 family: indistinguishable on screen, one value would be better); 2, 2.2 and 2.4 are the heavier line of 12-14 px glyphs. Other lines (1.5, 1.6, 1.7, 2.6, 2.8, 3, 4) are flagged.
icons.rule: one meaning, one icon, only from ui/icons.js (owner 2026-10-07: «Иконка Adjustments неверная. Нужно, чтобы это было систематизировано ... консистентные иконки, консистентные стили, консистентные цвета»). The registry HY_TOOL_IC names each glyph by its meaning (the comment after it); a page or a plugin draws an icon with hyIcon(name, size, line, cls), <svg data-ic=name> in static markup, hyIconPath(name) on a canvas or the --hy-ic-* CSS images, and writes no <path>, <circle> or <rect> of its own (validate.py icon-inline). A name is one glyph, a glyph is one name, every name asked for exists (icon-registry); a glyph is drawn in currentColor (icon-color), the one exception Raw Editor's «on» disc (hyGradeIcon). A table of older names (ui/menu.js NAME, Image Studio's ICON_NAME, 3D Studio's FAMILY) is marked hy-icon-names and points only at registry names.
icons.name_tables: a comment with hy-icon-names on the line of a table's opening brace (or the line above): its string values are registry names

allow_files.hyimg/review/ui/projicon.js: the pictograms a person picks for a project on Home (stored by name in home.json, beside the emoji): a catalog of pictures, not the app's meanings

marks.source: canvas.html .mk and MK (owner 2026-10-06: «inconsistencies in item badges across the board, padding rules, sizing, disappearing rules»)
marks.note_why: the note mark is a plain 12 px dot with a thin dark ring, not a plate (owner 2026-10-06: «before, like the blue dot, it worked perfectly»)
marks.live: the runtime audit takes the plate and the inset from canvas.html MK when the page has it (the marks were being redesigned on 2026-10-06: 26 px, 8.5 px inset); the numbers here are the fallback

fonts.why: the pages' --sans; the slider's number and code in Geist Mono; «SF Pro Text» is the studio look's --sans (ui/studio.css). Sizes: 12 (72 uses), 13 (47), 11 (39), 10, 14, 15, 18; 12.5 (24) and 11.5 (13) are in-between sizes worth folding into 12 and 11

shadows.--plate-sh: ui/look.css, a panel or a menu (cv.shadow: 1, panels, 0 the default; none at 0)
shadows.--hy-sh-ctl: ui/ui.css, a control on the surface (flat at 0)
shadows.--hy-sh-pop: ui/ui.css, a panel or menu over it (flat at 0)
shadows.--hy-sh-row: ui/look.css, ui/hy/plate.css: a plate of the top row, a mode's hint plate, a dock (flat at panels and 0)
shadows.--hy-sh-row-ctl: ui/ui.css: the same in the control depth (flat at panels and 0)

colors.rule: colours only by tokens (owner 2026-10-07: «консистентные цвета»): a CSS declaration takes var(--ink), var(--sel) and the rest; a hex, rgb() or hsl() is written only as a token's value (--name: #...), in a var() fallback, or where it is not a colour of the interface: a mask's alpha (mask, -webkit-mask), a drawn swatch of a colour itself (a hue track). validate.py css-color; what is known is in design/baseline.json

prose.about: panel prose (owner 2026-10-06, 3D Studio's Scene panel in white body text: «Вот эти комментарии никто не читает ... микро шрифтом, как Apple обычно делает ... Если текст не ключевой, то зачем он вообще нужен»): an explanation in a panel, popover, empty state or setting is not written when it is not key, one footnote line (ui/hy/hint.css .hy-hint or <hy-hint>, key words in <b>) when it is, a ⓘ (.hy-info, the text in its tooltip) when something is really unclear. Static: scripts/validate.py panel-prose; runtime: design/audit.js prose
prose.why_skip: agentnote: the hidden note for an AI agent, not shown; the person's or an agent's own words (a prompt, a notification's text, a version's name, a frame's answers) and the shortcuts reference (#keys, the viewer's ?) are content, not explanation

inset.about: the inset check (design/audit.js inset, owner 2026-10-06): px from a control's content to its rounded edge

top_row.about: the top row in every mode (design/audit.js top-row, owner 2026-10-07: «breadcrumb area тоже разношерстная»): the plates whose top is within band px of the window's top and that are no taller than max_h (the window buttons' capsule, the library button, the crumb, a title plate after it, «To the original», the round buttons, Home's search and «New board», Image Studio's Save) stand top px down, height px tall, gutter px from the window's sides, gap px from a neighbour (a plate nearer than near px), with one glass, one shadow, one corner and text px words; a mode's hint plate (hint) is one of them under the row, under px from the top and gutter in (Image Studio's options ride over the dock on the board since 2026-10-08, round 11 D3: there they are no hint plate); the side panels (panels) start under px from the top; nothing lies on a band a page draws as the window's edge (window.hyEdges(), Image Studio's rulers); no note (toasts) covers a plate of the row. The tokens: ui/look.css --hy-row-top, --hy-row-gut, --hy-row-gap, --hy-plate-h, --hy-row-under, the look .hy-plate

disagreements: easing: DESIGN.md names cubic-bezier(.3,.8,.25,1) the main curve, the code uses cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1) 114 times against 19; both are in the contract, (.32,.72,0,1) is THE curve for new work
row heights: panel rows are 32 px (#sets, .hy-search, #ctx), the slider beside them 34 px (--hy-sl-h), the library's header select and search 34 px, the board's library head .lhead 32 px
seg buttons: 28 px in the board's settings (#sets .seg > button), 26 px in Home's settings (the same panel by DESIGN.md «Меню и настройки»)
menu rows: the board's #ctx and the library's #lctx 32 px, Home's .menu 30 px
selection bars: the board's dock buttons 34 px, the library's .pickbar 30 px
menus' z-index: Home's .menu 50, the board's #ctx 60, the library's #lctx 70
icon lines: 1.8 (26 uses), 1.85 (the family), 1.9 (menus) for one family
font sizes: 12.5 px (24 uses) and 11.5 px (13) between the scale's 12 and 11
